unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe from optional notification emails
unsubscribe.description: Are you sure you want to unsubscribe from optional news, reminders, and nurture emails from La So Viet? You will continue to receive essential transactional emails such as order confirmations, password resets, and report completion notices.
unsubscribe.success_message: You have been unsubscribed from optional news and reminder emails. Essential transactional emails will still be delivered normally.
unsubscribe.error_invalid_or_expired: The unsubscribe link is invalid or has expired.
unsubscribe.error_no_token: No valid unsubscribe confirmation token was found.
